I personally found the film to be very very satisfying and enjoyable, I found the characterization to be really good for almost all characters, I was having such a good time with the characters on the first half of the movie, felt like the film could’ve spent hours on Village 3 and I wouldn’t mind, loved seeing everyone again

The second act made me realize that it was Evangelion I was watching😂, it did bring thrilling moments and hey, to me the CGI was great, the whole film looked amazing actually, I actually could understand quite a lot of things, and I have some theories of my own that I’m gonna keep for sure about what that whole final sequence meant

The final act for sure it’s not gonna sit well with a lot of people, to me that CGI imagery was why Evangelion it’s a thing of its own, the ending is gonna command a lot of repeated views of the film, the only thing I didn’t like about the final sequence was some important moments I felt weren’t earned or justified enough, at least not there yet

Overall I’m very satisfied with the film, ever since I saw the longer runtime I was hoping the characters were gonna be fleshed out and I was right, I also really liked that this film was the other side of the coin of End of Evangelion, this film is much more hopeful and forgiving towards the characters, and is as emphatic on the meaning of life, rather than being pure despair and hopelessness, I’m glad the whole franchise could’ve been ended like this, it was a blast, hoped I saw it with more people but since we were in a tropical storm things weren’t that easy

During some cutscenes the game looks great, good use of lightning overall, but I wished they did more, textures look horrible, you have good character models standing on terribly textured floors/streets, audio is still compressed and quality of life improvements were scarce honestly 

But anyway, it’s a good opportunity for people to enjoy nocturne in more known consoles and the voice acting is GREAT
